definitions.gloss: to pull in, to draw into
definitions.explanation: To bring or draw something or someone into a space or situation.
To get someone involved in a situation, often unwillingly.

examples.english: To draw customers into the store.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む is a compound verb meaning to pull/draw into. Transitive godan verb.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The 〜{込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of entering or going deeply into.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む: to draw customers into a store
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{込|こ}まれる: to be drawn into a story
- ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む: to drag into trouble

TRANSITIVITY:
- {引|ひ}き{込|こ}む (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧): to pull in
- ⟦{引|ひ}きこもる→引きこもる：19546_hikikomoru⟧ (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧): to shut oneself in, withdraw

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{引|ひ}きこもり→引きこもり：10491_hikikomori⟧ refers to social withdrawal or a person who stays isolated at home.
